stem: A pipeline stage runs three test actions in parallel. Occasionally one action fails because of a short network problem while the other two succeed. The team wants to rerun only the failed action without starting the pipeline from the beginning or rerunning the successful actions. The team also wants the stage to be retried automatically once when it fails. Which actions should the team take? (Choose TWO.)

choices.text: Use Retry failed actions on the stage when an action fails.
Configure automatic retry on stage failure for the stage, with one retry attempt.
Use Retry failed stage, which reruns only the actions that failed.
Choose Release change to run the pipeline again from the source stage.
Configure automatic retry on stage failure with three retry attempts to cover longer problems.

explanation.summary: 失敗した段階は、パイプラインを最初から動かさずにやり直せる。失敗したアクションをやり直す（retry failed actions）と、失敗したアクションだけが動き直す。失敗した段階をやり直す（retry failed stage）と、段階の最初のアクションから全てが動き直す。段階の失敗の自動のやり直しは、1 回だけ設定できる。

per_choice.A: 正しい。失敗したアクションだけがもう一度動く。
per_choice.B: 正しい。自動のやり直しは 1 回だけ設定できる。
per_choice.C: retry failed stage は段階の全てのアクションを最初からやり直す。
per_choice.D: パイプラインを最初から動かすことになり、要件に反する。
per_choice.E: 自動のやり直しは 1 回までしか設定できない。

references.quote: Retrying a failed stage retries all actions in the stage from the first action in the stage, and retrying failed actions retries all failed actions in the stage.
You can only configure automatic retry on stage failure for one retry attempt.
You can retry a stage that has failed without having to run a pipeline again from the beginning.
